summary: Home page layouts (index and curated), search and discovery entry points.

screens.notes: Reference switches the tweaks-panel Home Layout to 'Curated · featured-first' (homeLayout=curated). The app uses the documented URL override so no forbidden on-page layout toggle is required.

screens.reason: The modular reference has no independently routeable search-results state; the command palette row (app.shell.palette) covers the search affordance.
No independently configured active-reference state exists for advanced search.
